source_title: Gisele Bündchen Supported by Husband Joaquim Valente in Rare Outing as She’s Honored at Charity Gala - People.com
source_excerpt:
“It reminds me that even the smallest acts of kindness can grow into something extraordinary,” Bündchen said of the honor
Gisele Bündchen and Karlie Kloss received Lotus House’s It Takes a Village award for supporting women and children on Thursday, Oct. 29
Bündchen and Joaquim Valente dressed as cowboys for the Miami shelter’s Halloween-themed gala
The couple married in December 2025 after welcoming their first child together earlier that year
Gisele Bündchen got dressed up for a good cause, and her husband Joaquim Valente was right there for it.
Lotus House , Miami’s largest women and children’s shelter, hosted its annual gala with a Halloween-inspired theme of “Sparkles and Costumes” on Thursday, Oct. 29.
Bündchen and Karlie Kloss received the “It Takes a Village” award “for their dedication to being hands-on champions of Lotus House” at the event, according to a press release.
“I’m so grateful to be part of the Lotus House family, where an incredible team and volunteers work with so much love to give women and children hope for a brighter future,” she said in a press statement. “It reminds me that even the smallest acts of kindness can grow into something extraordinary.”
Photos from the event shared with PEOPLE show Bündchen and Valente attending dressed as cowboys.
Bündchen wore her hair in two braids under a hat, and a plaid shirt with jeans. Valente complemented her look with a tan shirt underneath a brown vest, a buckle belt, and jeans.
The supermodel shared her own photos from the event on Instagram and further expressed her appreciation for the award.
“If there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s that kindness works like a seed,” she said. “Even the smallest act can make a difference. When we show up for one another, we don’t just plant hope, we help it grow into something extraordinary. ❤️.”
Bündchen and Valente wed in an intimate ceremony in December 2025, less than a year after they welcomed their first child together in February 2025.
In March, a source told PEOPLE that Bündchen feels “really happy being married” and has a deeper sense of fulfillment with her daily life.
“It [marriage] didn’t change their day-to-day life in a big way, but it made things feel more meaningful,” the source said. “It was a very special moment for them to celebrate with close family and friends.”
